domain: industrial facility survival / environmental reporting compliance
prediction_question: For a facility that reported pollutant releases to Canada's National Pollutant Release Inventory for reporting year Y, will it report nothing at all to the NPRI for year Y+1 (exit the reporting population), given only its reporting history through year Y?
prediction_time: June 1 of year Y+1: the statutory deadline for year-Y NPRI reports (NPRI reports for a calendar year are due by June 1 of the following year, per the publisher's Canada Gazette NPRI notices and reporting guides). At that instant the facility's full history through year Y is knowable, and its year-Y+1 outcome is not - the Y+1 report would not even be due until June 1 of Y+2, and the publisher publishes each reporting year's data later still (the 2024 single-year file is the latest published as of 2026-10-19). Features are strictly year-Y and earlier; every year-Y+1 field is the label source and never ships.
target_definition: Binary and mechanical, from the publisher's own per-year products: positive iff NPRI_ID is present in the year-Y single-year data file and absent from the year-Y+1 file. NPRI_ID is the publisher's permanent facility identifier (measured: facility NPRI ID 1 carries the same ID across 2021-2024 files). Absence means the facility reported no releases/disposals/transfers for that reporting year - the documented outcome of closure, falling below reporting thresholds, or ceasing to meet criteria; the task does not need to distinguish those causes because the label is the publisher's own reporting record, not a judgement.

license_evidence: Measured 2026-10-19: CKAN package_show for both NPRI packages ('Single year data tables by facility' 348504f1-..., 'Bulk data files for all years' 40e01423-...) return license_title 'Open Government Licence - Canada', publisher organization 'Environment and Climate Change Canada' (ec).

OGL-Canada 2.0 attribution requirement carries through unchanged on any release (title of the information, name of the source, link to the licence); no share-alike or non-commercial restriction; source terms preserved verbatim per the standing policy.

Publisher caveat to carry: NPRI data are facility-reported estimates with per-row Estimation_Method codes (E1-E5/M1-M5 etc., documented in the NPRI guides) and known reporting-threshold effects; the ECCC scoping review itself flags 'reporting compliance and uncertainty in estimation methods' as a data-quality limitation.
split_strategy: Temporal by the outcome year Y+1 (label year): train Y+1 in 2005-2015, eval 2016-2019, holdout 2020-2023. 2024 exists (38,762,396 bytes, 7,986+ facilities) but 2025 is not yet published, so 2024 exits are not observable; 2024 rows serve as feature history only. Measured base rates (full NPRI_ID set comparisons over complete single-year files): 2021->2022 exit 902/7,322 = 12.32%; 2022->2023 815/7,521 = 10.84% - both classes amply present every year; ~800-900 positives per recent year means train (~11 label years) ~5-9k positives, eval ~3-4k, holdout ~3-4k (pre-2010 years have fewer facilities; counts to be recomputed from the bulk file at construction). Positives cluster by facility (a facility can exit at most once, but its history spans many year-rows), so the facility is the clustered unit: runner id = unique (NPRI_ID, Y) row key, NPRI_ID ships only as a declared high-cardinality column, never the id column.

measurements.file_location_2026_10_19: The download URLs recorded in CKAN for the bulk files (data-donnees.ec.gc.ca/data/...) serve a 2,200-byte HTML SPA, not the data. Measured working path: https://data-donnees.az.ec.gc.ca/api/file?path=<url-encoded path> answers ranged GETs with 206 and the real bytes (single-year 2023 CSV: 40,400,423 B total; bulk Releases 1993-present CSV: 393,281,064 B total).
measurements.per_year_shape_2026_10_19: Single-year CSVs measured in full (downloaded to coordinator scratch, deleted afterwards): 2021 36,460,887 B / 56,115 rows / 7,322 distinct NPRI_IDs; 2022 39,154,265 B / 60,202 rows / 7,521; 2023 40,400,423 B / 62,125 rows / 7,986. 2024 measured via ranged HEAD-equivalent: 38,762,396 B (rows not counted). Wide schema, 77 columns: Year, NPRI ID, Company, Facility, City, CSD, CMA, Economic Region, Province, Postal Code, ecozone, watershed, Latitude, Longitude, NAICS 4/6 codes + titles, CAS Number, Substance Name (EN/FR), Units, then per-media release columns (Air: Stack/Storage/Fugitive/Spills/Other/Total; Water: Direct Discharge/Spills/Leaks/...; Land columns further right).
measurements.exit_rates_2026_10_19: Full NPRI_ID set comparisons: 2021->2022 present 7,322, absent next year 902 (12.32%), new entrants 1,101; 2022->2023 present 7,521, absent 815 (10.84%), entrants 1,280.
measurements.units_frame_warning_measured: Quantities arrive in MIXED units per row: 2023 file measured units = tonnes 57,570 rows, kg 4,221, grams 167, 'g TEQ' 167 (dioxin toxicity equivalents). Any threshold or aggregation across rows MUST normalize by the Units column first - the same silent wrong-answer failure mode the NOAA datum fix addressed; construction must pin a known-event/aggregate cross-check (e.g. total facility releases vs the publisher's published provincial/sector summary tables).
measurements.spill_alternative_measured: The alternative 'will the facility report any spill-category release next year' formulation was measured and rejected for this source's primary task: spill-carrying facility-years are only 110/7,322 (1.50%) in 2021, 114/7,521 (1.51%) 2022, 149/7,986 (1.87%) 2023 - too thin and heavily clustered to carry a scored holdout; recorded as candidates/npri-facility-spill-year (dropped).
measurements.extraction_cost_2026_10_19: Measured on the coordinator: three single-year CSVs (36.5-40.4 MB each, 116 MB total) downloaded and fully parsed in 183 s wall clock (single process, csv module) - roughly 0.6 MB/s effective including parse. Construction from the bulk files is ~400 MB for releases plus disposals/transfers/geolocations files (ESTIMATE from measured releases size; other bulk files not sized) or ~40 MB per single-year file; a 1993-2023 build is a modest worker job (~7,000-8,000 facilities/year, ~56-62k rows/year in the single-year files, bulk list-format rows several times that).

next_action: GO to construction (advancement session owns it). Construction step: on a worker, download the bulk releases CSV (az.ec.gc.ca api/file path, ~393 MB) plus geolocations, or the per-year single-year CSVs for the chosen window; decode as cp1252 (measured: accents garble under UTF-8); build the (NPRI_ID, Y) facility-year panel from year-Y and earlier reports (substance mix, per-media quantities NORMALIZED BY UNITS - tonnes/kg/grams/gTEQ measured mixed in one file, NAICS 4/6, province, facility age, prior exit-adjacent signals like shrinking substance counts), label = NPRI_ID absent from the Y+1 file, exclude every Y+1 field from shipped columns and assert absence, freeze train labels 2005-2015 / eval 2016-2019 / holdout 2020-2023, runner id = unique (NPRI_ID, Y) key with NPRI_ID declared high-cardinality, pin the measured recent exit rates (10.8-12.3%) as the cross-check fixture, then run the qualification gate on the worker over the full artifact.

prior_art: ECCC scoping review of NPRI use in environmental research (canada.ca fact sheet); US EPA TRI toolbox and PEMS literature; no NPRI or TRI reporting-exit task found in ML-ready form
novelty_check.theirs: ECCC publishes the raw NPRI (1993-present); its own scoping review shows 225 research articles use NPRI as input to exposure and air-quality models, not as a prediction target; US TRI work is data-standardization and real-time stack-emissions (PEMS), not annual reporting-outcome prediction with splits
novelty_check.ours: Facility-year task on Canada's NPRI: predict whether a facility that reported in year Y reports nothing at all in Y+1, from its full substance/media/quantity history (units-normalized), temporal splits, leak-free by construction
novelty_check.rule: A dataset that already exists in ML-ready form is not published. Mirroring is a failure mode, not a contribution.
